about: Powell River is a city on British Columbia’s northern Sunshine Coast, on the Strait of Georgia between Vancouver Island and the mainland. Pulp-and-paper heritage, coastal inlets, and ferry links via Horseshoe Bay and Comox define a rainforest community apart from Metro Vancouver. About 14,000 people live in Powell River.
